definitions.explanation: A collective term for fresh fruits and vegetables, especially in commercial and market contexts. Literally 'green goods.'

examples.japanese: {青果|せいか}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I picked out vegetables in the produce section.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{青果|せいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This market has a rich selection of fresh produce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{青果|せいか}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧や⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: A new produce shop opened near the station, making it possible to get fresh local vegetables and fruits.

notes:
A compound of {青|せい} (green, fresh) and {果|か} (fruit). Used primarily in commercial and business contexts rather than casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青果|せいか}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (produce shop, greengrocer)
- {青果|せいか}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (produce market, wholesale fruit and vegetable market)
- {青果|せいか}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (produce section in a supermarket)
- {青果|せいか}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (produce sales area)

In supermarkets, the produce section is typically labeled {青果|せいか} alongside ⟦{精肉|せいにく}→精肉：14826_seiniku⟧ (meat), ⟦{鮮魚|せんぎょ}→鮮魚：16483_sengyo⟧ (fresh fish), and ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (deli/prepared foods). In everyday conversation, people usually say ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ rather than {青果|せいか}.
